items.title: Nvidia stock bounces as Trump administration pushes for rehiring of Jensen Huang
items.content: Shares in Nvidia rose on Monday after a weekend of more developments, including the Trump administration pushing for the reinstatement of Jensen Huang to lead the company.

items.title: Cybersecurity stocks have been hot — and now CrowdStrike inks deal to buy Zscaler
items.content: CrowdStrike on Monday said it will acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction that values the company at approximately $43.9 billion.

items.title: Google co-founder Sergey Brin and ex-wife Nicole Shanahan list Malibu home for $33.5 million
